Supplement.title: Supplement
Supplement.description: Represents a vitamin, medication, or daily health supplement routine tracked by a user.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated owner.

name.description: Name of the vitamin, supplement, or medication (1-80 chars).

dosage.description: Dosage description such as 1000 IU, 500 mg, or 1 Kapsül (1-40 chars).

takenToday.description: Whether the dose has been taken today.

notes.description: Optional usage instructions or notes (up to 200 chars).

VitalLog.title: VitalLog
VitalLog.description: Represents a health vital measurement, hydration log, or wellness expense entry.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated owner.

type.description: Type of vital or wellness log.

title.description: Label or title for the measurement (1-80 chars).

primaryValue.description: Primary measurement value (e.g. ml of water, systolic BP, BPM, weight kg, glucose mg/dL, sleep hours, expense TL).

secondaryValue.description: Secondary measurement value (e.g. diastolic BP, or 0 if not applicable).

unit.description: Measurement unit (e.g. ml, mmHg, BPM, kg, mg/dL, saat, TL).

note.description: Optional note about the measurement (up to 200 chars).

/users/{userId}/supplements/{supplementI.description: Per-user collection of daily vitamins, medications, and supplements.

/users/{userId}/vital_logs/{logId}.description: Per-user collection of hydration, vital signs, sleep, and health expense logs.
